# FE-008 typed integration and responsibility audit — 2026-10-29

**Contract source:** clean backend commit `e5f563456efd1b29a67a36805c2b3775ce2f9d06` generated by FE-EN-002. This checkpoint changes frontend source only; the generated OpenAPI and `SOURCE.json` are owned by the contract-sync task.

## Implemented

- `data-access/src/api/documents/issuer-settings.api.ts`: generated request and response types for active settings, immutable version creation and activation. The settings page keeps separate create and activate actions and reuses a request ID after an uncertain response.
- `data-access/src/api/quotes/quote-document-endpoints.ts`: generated `prepareCrmQuote` and `renderCrmQuotePdf` request bodies, PDF artifact status and shared authenticated blob request. A ready response must match the requested quote and version; downloaded content must be `application/pdf`, 5 bytes–20 MiB and start with `%PDF-`.
- `feature/src/pages/documents/{issuer-settings-page,use-issuer-settings-editor}.tsx/ts`: display and write state are separate. The page validates editable values, shows active settings, creates a version, then asks for explicit activation.
- `feature/src/components/documents/{quote-documents-panel,use-quote-documents,save-quote-pdf}.tsx/ts`: display, server action state/polling, and browser save are separate. The quote editor locks competing writes during ready/render/download. A failed or uncertain prepare retains its request ID for retry. A ready quote can call render again after reload to recover the server artifact ID; queued/processing artifacts poll the status endpoint.
- `feature/src/clients.routes.tsx`, Admin React `legacy-menu.ts` and route test: issuer settings navigation. The ready/PDF panel is mounted in the existing quote editor.

The first run exposed that missing mock and failed 5/7; the regression run passed.
- `libs/admin/clients/feature`: `node ../../../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/errors/documents/issuer-settings-error.unit.test.ts` — **2/2 passed**, including explicit Admin-only `403` and version conflict `409` guidance.
- TypeScript: `tsc --noEmit -p libs/admin/clients/{data-access,feature}/tsconfig.lib.json`, `tsc --noEmit -p libs/admin/clients/{data-access,feature}/tsconfig.spec.json`, and `tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin-react/tsconfig.spec.json` passed. The existing quote editor callback now explicitly returns `undefined` when calculation is locked so app test typechecking passes.
- Prettier on changed FE-008 source and `git diff --check` passed.

## Acceptance boundary

The HTTP test server uses synthetic settings, quote and PDF bytes. It proves transport shape and guards, not renderer layout, multipage output, visible tax/legal copy, logo, embedded private file exclusion, accessibility, or a browser session against a running backend. Those manual acceptance checks remain open; full FE-008 release acceptance is not claimed. The existing static service-manager menu shows the issuer settings link to non-Admin users too; the page now explains `403` on read/write, while backend `403` remains authoritative for Admin-only settings mutations. Role-aware menu visibility would require a separate navigation change.

## Follow-up structure and access-loss audit

The later requested audit moved FE-008 hooks/browser save to `feature/src/hooks/documents/`, grouped quote document API under `data-access/src/api/quotes/documents/`, and added private cache/local-artifact clearing on 403/404. See [AF-FE-P5-002–005](../code-audit/audit.md#p5-fe-008fe-011-follow-up-structure-audit--2026-10-29). The original commands above describe the integration checkpoint before these file moves. Fresh post-refactor checks: document HTTP 3/3, access-loss API 3/3, hook state 2/2, editor 7/7, data-access/feature production TypeScript and data-access spec TypeScript passed. The hook test first failed 2/2 because typed API errors displayed only a generic fallback; after the formatter fix it passed 2/2 and confirmed 403 clears the artifact while 500 retains it for retry. Manual rendered PDF and role-aware menu acceptance remain open.
